idea-plugin.name: Background ReadAction Freeze Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Flags a background-thread entry point (a `Task.Backgroundable` override, an `Application#executeOnPooledThread(...)` task, or a task submitted to `AppExecutorUtil`'s pooled executor) that can reach a blocking, non-cancellable read-lock call -- either directly, or transitively through a project method whose own summary already proves it. Two tiers, both verified against the real `intellij-community` source rather than assumed: Tier 1 (`ReadAction.compute()`/`run()`/`computeCancellable()`) is formally `@Deprecated`; Tier 2 (`Application#runReadAction(...)`) is not formally deprecated, but its own Javadoc says "Avoid using this method directly in applied/plugins code" -- it's the same blocking, non-cancellable read lock underneath.

Motivated by JetBrains' own Platform Blog: "Investigating IntelliJ Platform UI Freezes" (Sept 2025) and "UI Freezes and the Dangers of Non-Cancellable Read Actions in Background Threads" (March 2026), which states that "many reports actually show problems in plugins that contain that single erroneous pattern" -- and that detection today is manual, post-mortem thread-dump analysis, not static prevention. This plugin is an attempt at the static side.

Interprocedural: reuses the same real, from-scratch Tarjan's SCC algorithm and whole-project fixed-point summary computation already proven in this catalog's Log Injection Companion and Interprocedural Resource Leak Companion, applied to a simpler reachability lattice.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only Java PSI (no Kotlin coroutines -- `Dispatchers.Default`/`IO` entry points are out of scope); `call.resolveMethod()` resolves a virtual call to a single candidate (no CHA, no points-to, same caveat already accepted catalog-wide); a project with more than 3,000 analyzable methods skips analysis entirely; a hit where the same method also calls `checkCanceled()` is downgraded to a weaker warning, not suppressed -- the write lock can still block.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

localInspection.displayName: Background thread reaches a non-cancellable ReadAction
